rules.statement: A treatment product's withdrawal period must be a whole number of days, zero or more.
rules.subject: treatment product withdrawal period

rules.statement: Two treatment products cannot share the same name.
rules.subject: treatment product name

rules.statement: Only the hive's owner can record a treatment on that hive.
rules.subject: treatment recorder

rules.statement: A treatment's end date must be the same as or later than its start date.
rules.subject: treatment end date
